messages:
Sarah K.: FYI Nimbus Media autopay charge failed for invoice #5544 — customer saw \"card_decline: insufficient_funds\" but our gateway logs also show a 3DS challenge delivered. Escalating to payments + fraud. cc @Raj @Ana

Raj P.: can you drop the raw webhook payload (sanitized) and the charge id? need to see acquirer response headers

Sarah K.: pasted below (sanitized):
```
{\n  \"charge_id\": \"ch_NM_5544\",\n  \"customer_id\": \"cust_nimbus_21\",\n  \"attempts\": [\n    { \"ts\": \"2026-11-18T15:03:12Z\", \"result\": \"decline\", \"decline_code\": \"insufficient_funds\", \"acquirer_code\": \"51\", \"acquirer_message\": \"Insufficient funds\" },\n    { \"ts\": \"2026-11-18T15:03:40Z\", \"result\": \"3ds_triggered\", \"3ds\":{\"acs_url\":\"https://acs.gatewayex.com/flow\",\"pareq\":\"...\"}, \"psp\": \"gateway-ex-eu\" }\n  ]\n}\n```

Marco L.: Merchant says autopay must be silent (no redirect). They want us to retry with a fallback acquirer instead of surfacing 3DS. Is that doable without merchant UX?

Ana G.: Fraud: BIN 5110XX has a modest velocity bump but risk score still low. AVS in the acquirer response shows mismatch on postal_code. Multiple attempts in short span cause some acquirers to flip to challenge mode. Could be both insufficient balance + AVS triggering 3DS.

Liam O.: Note we recently adjusted default routing to prefer gateway-ex-eu for cost reasons; that gateway enforces stricter 3DS for certain card ranges. Merchant-level setting allow_challenge_skip=false overrides their previous silent autopay setting. That mismatch explains the mixed signals.

Raj P.: Quick engineer repro (test token) — will hit our charges endpoint and demonstrate either an immediate 51 decline or a 3ds_required response: 

curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/charges \
  -H \"Authorization: Bearer sk_live_nimbus\" \
  -H \"Idempotency-Key: repro-nimbus-01\" \
  -d \"amount=2500\" \
  -d \"currency=usd\" \
  -d \"customer=cust_nimbus_21\" \
  -d \"card_token=tok_master_5110\" \
  -d \"autopay=true\" \
  -d \"prefer_silent=true\"

Expected: either {\"status\":\"declined\", \"decline_code\":\"insufficient_funds\"} OR {\"status\":\"requires_action\", \"3ds_required\": true, \"acs_url\": \"...\"}

Sarah K.: Immediate mitigations proposed: 1) flip targeted routing for cust_nimbus_21 to gateway-y (lower 3DS enforcement) 2) enable a silent failover that retries on a different PSP for autopay-only flows 3) advise merchant to add backup payment method and confirm AVS/billing address. Which should we push?

Raj P.: I can push a feature-flagged routing override for this merchant (take them off gateway-ex-eu) — low risk, reversible. ETA: 1 business day to deploy and monitor.

Ana G.: Also recommend flagging the BIN and watching for further AVS mismatches. I'll add a short-lived rule to raise alerts on repeat declines from the same BIN within 2 hours.

Marco L.: I'll send Nimbus a concise note with the repro token and the three options. They prefer silent behavior; ask them if they accept a routing override (we'll monitor cost delta).

Liam O.: Ops: we'll add a cost guard (alert if PSP spend > 2x normal for that merchant) and rollback rule. Ops-bot, open incident.

ops-bot: incident created INC-3201; assigned to Raj P.; priority=P2; watchers: Ana G., Liam O., Marco L.

Sarah K.: thanks all — replying to Nimbus now with explanation: mixed failure modes (51 insufficient funds vs 3DS enforcement), propose routing override + backup card. will update ticket with merchant decision.

Raj P.: I'll own the routing override rollout and smoke test. tagging payments-eng for visibility.

Ana G.: I'll follow up with fraud ops recommended steps for AVS.

Marco L.: copying the repro steps to the support ticket.

Sarah K.: :thumbsup: closing loop here, will post update once merchant confirms which mitigation they want.
